clue.text: Sort of clue, like 'Vault'?

parts.note: a vault is an underground burial chamber, a crypt
the suffix -ic forms adjectives meaning like or of the nature of

explanation.surface: A puzzler asks whether a one-word clue such as 'Vault' counts as a particular type.
explanation.walkthrough: The quoted 'Vault' looks like a sample clue, but it is just a synonym for the chamber; adding the adjective ending gives a word meaning 'like a crypt'.
explanation.definitionFit: A cryptic clue is the puzzling kind found in this very crossword, as opposed to a plain quick-style one.

clue.text: Transfer coppers

definitions.meaning: to switch from one train or bus to another

explanation.definitionFit: You change trains when transferring, and copper coins are small change in the pocket.

clue.text: Once the sign of farmers of old

parts.note: ye is the archaic written form of the definite article, so 'the' as once written
an omen is a sign of things to come

explanation.surface: An old omen once foretold the fate of farmers long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: Historically yeomen were small freeholding farmers who worked their own land in England.

clue.text: Dame Thora in address, perhaps, with promise to go round fifty developing nations

parts.note: actress Dame Thora Hird, written on an envelope with her initial as T Hird

indicators.note: the promise word is placed around the numeral for fifty

parts.note: to give your word is to promise
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A letter to the actress Dame Thora pledges help to poorer countries.
explanation.walkthrough: Thora Hird was a much-loved British comic actress; her name written with an initial, as on an envelope, gives the first word.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase was the standard term for poorer, developing nations outside the two Cold War blocs.

clue.text: Noise from family gathering at the outset

parts.note: a clan is an extended family group

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the word gathering is taken

explanation.surface: A family reunion starts off with a racket.
explanation.definitionFit: A clang is a loud ringing metallic sound, a kind of noise.

clue.text: Post Office adopting poor Cable's possible remedy

indicators.note: the Post Office letters take in the other letters, holding them inside
poor signals that the letters of the politician's name are in bad shape and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written; the possessive adds no letter

explanation.surface: The Post Office takes on a struggling politician's proposed cure.
explanation.walkthrough: Cable suggests Vince Cable, the Liberal Democrat business secretary who oversaw Royal Mail's sale; 'poor' rearranges his name, held inside PO.
explanation.definitionFit: A placebo is a dummy treatment that may work as a remedy through belief alone.

clue.text: After dressing, journalist gets wasted

indicators.note: the journalist abbreviation is placed after the dressing word

parts.note: a plaster is a sticking dressing for a wound

explanation.surface: A reporter, once his wound is dressed, goes out and gets drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'plaster' is British for an adhesive bandage.
explanation.definitionFit: Plastered and wasted are both slang for very drunk.

clue.text: Religious book and play

definitions.meaning: the ... of the Apostles, a New Testament book
to perform or behave in a role

explanation.definitionFit: Acts is a book of the New Testament, and a person who plays a part acts it.

clue.text: Administrator finds copper deposit between river and hill

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon
a tor is a rocky hill, as on Dartmoor
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A manager discovers a seam of copper ore between a river and a hill.

clue.text: Performs better than banned theatre productions

parts.note: out can mean excluded or not allowed
plays are staged dramas

explanation.surface: Forbidden stage shows somehow outshine the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: To outplay rivals is to beat them by performing better in a game or contest.

clue.text: I love being hugged by boxer dressing

indicators.note: the boxer's name wraps around the other letters as if embracing them

parts.note: Muhammad Ali, the famous heavyweight boxer
love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O
love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O

explanation.definitionFit: Aioli is a garlic mayonnaise used as a sauce or salad dressing.

indicators.note: only the first letter of took is used

clue.text: Pig mixture of dry egg and suet

indicators.note: the following words are mixed up into a new order

explanation.surface: A recipe blends dry egg and suet into a pudding.
explanation.definitionFit: A pig is a glutton, and greedyguts is a British informal word for one.

clue.text: Fight expected with Liberal

parts.note: due means expected, as a train is due

explanation.definitionFit: A duel is a formal combat between two people, a kind of fight.

clue.text: Shot church official pinching new orb

parts.note: a canon is a clergyman attached to a cathedral
an orb is a sphere, a ball

explanation.surface: A cleric steals a brand-new globe.

clue.text: Prisoner raves about rightwing school of music

parts.note: con is short for convict, a prisoner

indicators.note: about signals the letters of raves are moved around

parts.note: a Tory is a right-wing Conservative

explanation.surface: An inmate rants about a right-wing academy for musicians.
explanation.definitionFit: A conservatory, or conservatoire, is a college for training musicians.

clue.text: Tops minimum amount of money invested in crafty solvers

indicators.note: the money letters are put inside the other letters, as money is put into a venture

explanation.walkthrough: 1p (one penny) is read as the letters IP, placed inside SLOVERS, the rearranged solvers.
explanation.definitionFit: Slipovers are sleeveless pullovers, tops worn over a shirt.

clue.text: 'Wannabe' when playing in part?

clue.text: Recently delivered gas for lighting a short lecture

parts.note: a talk is a lecture

clue.text: Fascinating session covering books

explanation.surface: A bookbinding class session proves enthralling.
explanation.definitionFit: Spellbinding means holding attention as if by magic, gripping or fascinating.

clue.text: Plug small cavity, full of energy

clue.text: Access for part of meal
